question1.question: Why is it important to assess Mr. P.C.P.'s psychomotor area?

answers.1: Observing Mr. P.C.P.'s motor behavior determines his ability to be ready to respond immediately to a situation.
answers.2: Observing Mr. P.C.P.'s motor behavior determines his ability to perform daily activities such as work, sleep, dressing, eating, among others.
answers.3: Observing Mr. P.C.P.'s motor behavior determines his ability to act based on established cultural values, generalize, and judge real situations.
answers.4: Observing Mr. P.C.P.'s motor behavior determines his ability to produce ideas and whether the content produced matches reality.
